name: lbdev
description: On-demand engineering workflow: plan, build with orchestrated subagents, review, security audit, plain-language explanations and git shipping. Injects nothing into context until one of its commands is run.

git_mode.title: Git mode
git_mode.description: pr: branch, commit, push and open a pull request (never merge). push: branch, commit and push, no PR. commit: local commits only. none: no git writes, print the commands instead.

autonomy.title: Planning autonomy
autonomy.description: ask: /lbdev:plan asks one questionnaire and one validation box. auto: it asks only blocking questions, skips the validation (running /lbdev:build approves the plan) and integrates kits the auditor accepted without security findings.

plans_dir.title: Plans directory
plans_dir.description: Working files (plans, ledgers, boards, saved explanations), relative to the project root. Kept out of git: lasting content is promoted to ADRs, the roadmap and the pull request.

max_fix_rounds.title: Max fix rounds
max_fix_rounds.description: How many review-then-fix rounds a task gets before it is parked and reported.

max_kits_per_role.title: Max kits per role
max_kits_per_role.description: How many kits (on-demand know-how files) one role may use.

source_dir.title: Plugin source (optional)
source_dir.description: Local checkout of this plugin's source, so /lbdev:improve can fix the plugin from its feedback log. Leave empty when the plugin is loaded with --plugin-dir from its source.
